verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,[1]
And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.[2]
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
His refuge[3] will be an abyss.[4]
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.

footnotes.1: The people will be as such after having been expelled from their graves.
footnotes.3: Literally, "mother" (a man's original refuge) , which will envelop him as in an embrace.
